contents.text:
There are five main skills that you can level up in this world.

The first is called Minecraft Level. You level this up by getting advancements, mining, and farming.
Minecraft Level is necessary for unlocking all trims and for gaining faster Category XP.

Next comes your category XP, of which there are four; one for each class, or category.

Your Warrior Level can be increased by killing mobs

Your Tank Level can be increasd by taking and tanking damage

Your Archer Level is increased by killing mobs with a bow

And finally, Wizard Level is increased by enchanting, drinking potions, and casting spells.
You can check all of these levels by running the command '/trigger playerLevel'
